national_scope: Six ordered pages of municipal query, archived within two seconds; daily current publication, not an immutable national version or historical 2025 census.
geometry_scope: Published representative points against published municipal polygon; no conversion of nominal accuracy into a hard error envelope.
identifier_scope: Exact nhstid/number string equality for same documented DiDok namespace; no diva_nr, prefix, parent, name or proximity inference. This does not merge operational points into commercial or physical stops.
remaining_gate: Comparable unique commercial/physical stop grouping and qualifying service; record identifiers, ORDERLY type and listed lines do not by themselves prove this.
